_doc: The Dawn of Man (world/dawn.js): a world begun before any town. Wandering clans settle good ground, villages grow into towns and bud new clans, towns gather villages into chiefdoms that become the realms. Years are 120 days.

lines.settle: The {clan} clan made camp {where} and stayed: {name} is founded.
lines.bud: Families of {name} set out as the {clan} clan, looking for land of their own.
lines.town: {name} has grown from a village into a town.
lines.chiefdom: {ruler} of {name} gathers the villages about it: the {realm} is born.
lines.path: A trodden path now joins {a} and {b}.

welcome: The world is young. No town stands, no crown is worn. You were born to the {clan} clan, wandering the wild with your kin — {kin}. Lead them to good ground and make camp for good, and watch the first villages rise.

birth._doc: Who the player is born among at the dawn (player/dawnBirth.js): a father, a mother and siblings, all of the clan; they walk with the player while the clan does and settle in its village.

hearth._doc: Kin share their pot (DawnBirth.kinMeal): with no food in your packs, at your clan's camp or in your home village, your family feeds you — up to maxOwed meals you haven't paid back. Come home with more food than keepFood and they take it into the pot, a unit for each meal owed.

lines.fed: You eat from your family's pot: {kin} share what they have.
lines.fedOwed: Your kin feed you again, but with a look: {owed} meals now that you have not paid back. Bring food to the pot.
lines.refused: Your kin have fed you {owed} times and you have brought nothing back. Tonight there is nothing for you in the pot: hunt, forage or bring food home.
lines.repaid: You add {qty} food to your family's pot.
lines.settled: Your clan makes camp for good. {name} is your people's home now — {kin} with you.
lines.settledAway: While you were away, your clan made camp for good: {name}. Your family lives there now.
lines.settleDesc: Your clan settles here for good and founds a village: your home. Choose well — fresh water, fertile land and the shore make a village grow.
